proposition: In the R. Suʾl al-Mulūk, written for Bāysunghur, Ibn Turka calculated from Shāhrukh's name that the Timurid state's glory would last one century, the whole of the ninth Islamic century.

mediation.who: Melvin-Koushki, paraphrasing or translating Ibn Turka's own work
mediation.note: a patronage text written for a Timurid prince
